email_change.confirm_old.subject: Please confirm your email change
email_change.confirm_old.headline: Changing your email address
email_change.confirm_old.body:
We received a request to change the email address on your Avodeck account. Please confirm that this was you.

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email and nothing will change.
email_change.confirm_new.subject: Please confirm your new email address
email_change.confirm_new.headline: Confirming your new email address
email_change.confirm_new.body:
This address was given as the new email address for an Avodeck account. Please confirm it so we can finish the change.

If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this email.
mfa.recovery_code_used.subject: One of your backup codes was used
mfa.recovery_code_used.headline: A backup code was used
mfa.recovery_code_used.body:
One of your backup codes was just used to sign in to your Avodeck account. If that was you, there is nothing more to do.

If it was not you, please change your password and make a new set of backup codes in your account.
notification.new.subject: You have a new message in Avodeck
notification.new.headline: You have a new message
notification.new.body:
There is a new message waiting for you in Avodeck.

Please sign in when you have a moment to read it.
notification.digest.subject: Your messages in Avodeck
notification.digest.headline: Your messages for today
notification.digest.body:
You have {count} new messages waiting for you in Avodeck.

Please sign in when you have a moment to read them.
deletion.certificate.subject: Your certificate of deletion
deletion.certificate.headline: The case has been deleted
invoice.sent.subject: Invoice {invoice_no} has been sent
invoice.sent.headline: Your invoice has been sent
invoice.sent.body:
Invoice {invoice_no} for {amount} {currency} has been sent. The case reference is {case_ref}.

You can download a copy from Avodeck whenever you need it. Thank you.
spot_check.code.subject: Your code to open the pages
spot_check.code.headline: Your code
spot_check.code.body:
Your code is {code}.

Please enter it when you are asked, to open the pages you were sent. Thank you.
org.invite.subject: You are invited to join a team on Avodeck
org.invite.headline: You are invited to join a team
org.invite.body:
You have been invited to join a team on Avodeck as {role}. Please accept the invitation to get started.

The invitation ends on {expires_on}. We hope to see you there.
case.reassigned.subject: A case has a new named expert
case.reassigned.headline: The named expert has changed
case.reassigned.body.outgoing:
You are no longer the named expert on a case in Avodeck. The case reference is {case_ref}.

Thank you for your work on it.
case.reassigned.body.incoming:
You are now the named expert on a case in Avodeck. The case reference is {case_ref}.

Please sign in when you are ready to take a look.
support_access.granted.subject: Avodeck support can look at one of your cases
support_access.granted.headline: Support can see one case
support_access.granted.body:
As you asked, Avodeck support can now look at one of your cases. The case reference is {case_ref}.

This access ends on {expires_at}. The access reference is {grant_ref}.
support.job_resumed.subject: Avodeck support restarted a paused job
support.job_resumed.headline: A paused job has been restarted
support.job_resumed.body:
Avodeck support set a paused job going again on one of your cases. The case reference is {case_ref}.

The job reference is {job_ref}. There is nothing you need to do.
support.job_requeued.subject: Avodeck support tried a failed job again
support.job_requeued.headline: A failed job has been tried again
support.job_requeued.body:
Avodeck support has asked for a job that did not finish to be tried again on one of your cases. The case reference is {case_ref}.

The job reference is {job_ref}. There is nothing you need to do.
account.created.subject: Your Avodeck account is ready
account.created.headline: Welcome to Avodeck
account.created.body:
An account has been made for you on Avodeck. Please choose your password to get started.

The link works for {link_hours} hour. If it has run out, just ask us and we will send you a new one.
help.request.subject: Help request ({topic})
help.request.headline: A help request
email.footer: This email was sent by Avodeck.
